title: The use of surfactants in the extraction of active ingredients from natural resources: a comprehensive review
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,23569-23587
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02072G, Review Article
Open Access

Bhupesh S. Samant, Raja Kaliappan
This review highlights novel surfactant-based extraction techniques i.e. micellar, pressurized, ultrasound, and microwave-assisted, that enhance bioactive compound isolation from plants, algae, microorganisms, and other natural sources.
